_comment: Counted ingredients (no weight or volume) that only come whole. 'not_scaled': left at the recipe's amount with the note, since a fraction of one means a different pan, not more of it (decided 2026-11-16; may change with feedback). 'whole_units': rounded to a whole number, at least 1, with a note when that changes it by more than a tenth. 'always_noted_units': rounded the same way, with the exact amount noted whenever it changes (eggs, decided 2026-11-16: round and show the exact so she can judge), followed by 'always_noted_tip' (how to measure part of one), only when the count was rounded (flag wg7cv). 'rough_units': rounded the same way with no note, they're rough to begin with. A crust with a weight is scaled by the weight like anything else; the others round only the count and leave a weight exact. Keywords are matched as whole words (plural allowed) against the unit and the ingredient part of the name (before the first comma).

not_scaled.note: Not scaled: a crust doesn't come in fractions. More or less filling usually means a bigger or smaller pan (or a second crust), depending on the pans you have.

always_noted_tip: For an exact amount, whisk one egg and measure part of it: a large egg is about 3 tablespoons, a yolk about 1, a white about 2.
